text:
Maya (oncall): Observed a sharp rise in embedding write latency and 429s for the ingest API in us-east-2 starting ~14:20 UTC. Impact: ~6% write failures and delayed downstream indexing. Declaring incident. Severity: S2. Status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2167891234

ingest-bot: alert: embed_ingest_queue_latency_high detected in us-east-2 (p99 queue_wait=12.4s) at 14:20:18 UTC.

Josh: Looking at worker metrics. The batch-aggregator process shows queue depth growing and one of the consumer worker pods is stuck in GC/stop-the-world. Suspect priority inversion in the batching scheduler that lets low-priority maintenance jobs starve ingest consumers.

Telemetry: Query: `sum(rate(embedding_ingest_429_total[1m])) by (region)` 7:20:00-14:25:00 UTC shows spike in us-east-2 to 6.3%

Infra: I see a recent config change at 13:55 UTC to `batch-prioritizer:max_maintenance_ratio=0.7`. That effectively allowed maintenance to take 70% of worker time. Rolling that value back to 0.1 as emergency mitigation. Command: `infractl set-config batch-prioritizer max_maintenance_ratio=0.1 --env prod --region us-east-2`

deploy-bot: config update recorded: batch-prioritizer.max_maintenance_ratio -> 0.1 at 14:24:02 UTC.

Josh: After config rollback, ingest queue wait p99 dropped from 12.4s -> 1.1s over 2 minutes. 429 rate decreased from 6.3% -> 0.6%. Restarted the stuck pod gracefully: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/ingest-worker -n ingest-us-east-2`

CS: Notifying impacted customers via status page and targeted DM for high-volume tenants. Draft update: "We experienced delayed embedding writes and elevated transient errors in us-east-2. We applied a config rollback and restarted affected workers; indexing backlog is clearing." Link: https://redwood.app/internal/comms/2167891234

Maya (oncall): Current status: mitigated (backlog draining, error rate returning to baseline). Monitoring for 45m. RCA owners: Josh (ingest), Infra (config), Telemetry (dashboards).

Telemetry: Suggest adding a guard: auto-pause maintenance jobs when queue_wait_p99 > 2s. Will add to follow-up list.

Infra: Follow-ups: add a pre-deploy canary check for `max_maintenance_ratio` changes and a deploy-time lint that prevents values above 0.2 in prod.

Josh: For postmortem I'll include the reproducer (local batch scheduler with high maintenance load), logs from the stuck worker, and config diff.

CS: Status page updated to "Operational (mitigated)" and top customers notified.

Maya (oncall): Closing thread unless we see recurrence. Thanks all.

(Agent notes: canonical doc and status page links above; owners: Josh/Infra/Telemetry/CS.)
